nodes.name: run_sprint9_validation.sh
nodes.summary: Sprint 9 validation suite shell script that verifies pytest marker registration and runs the comprehensive edge-case, stress, Monte-Carlo, and sensitivity test pipeline using explicit file targets for real signal.

nodes.name: sprint_16_test_suite.sh
nodes.summary: Sprint 16 comprehensive test-suite verification script that runs and tallies all Priority 1/2/3 deliverable tests plus regression checks, reporting colored pass/fail/skip counters for the finance-contracts feature branch.

nodes.name: tag_model_release.sh
nodes.summary: Release tagging helper that authenticates with the GitHub CLI, stages the debt module and YAML config, commits, creates an annotated DFI-checkpoint tag, and publishes a GitHub Release for institutional audit traceability.

nodes.name: validate_sensitivity_v14_gwtf.sh
nodes.summary: GWTF-compliant shell validator that grep-checks analytics/sensitivity_v14.py for banned imports/calls and required symbols (evaluate_scenario, SensitivityResult, _evaluate_base_kpis), exiting non-zero on any of seven structural failures.

nodes.name: venv_up.sh
nodes.summary: Sourced bootstrap script that detects the shell, locates the repo root, and creates then activates a Python 3.11 virtual environment, falling back across python3.11 candidates when the preferred interpreter is missing.

nodes.name: run_test
nodes.summary: Runs a single shell-command test case, incrementing the total/passed/failed counters and printing a colored pass or fail line based on the command's exit status.

nodes.name: run_pytest
nodes.summary: Executes a pytest target and folds its result into the suite's pass/fail/skip tallies, printing a colored status line so the Sprint 16 verification report reflects per-suite outcomes.

nodes.name: print_summary
nodes.summary: Prints the final pass/fail summary for the sensitivity_v14 validator, listing any accumulated error messages and signaling overall success or failure of the seven structural checks.
